# Information about this notebook

This notebook generates volcano plots to visualize and summarize DE patterns.

A volcano plot visualizes two key metrics for every gene:

- log₂ fold change (log2FC) — the magnitude and direction of expression change
- statistical significance — usually represented as –log₁₀(p-value)

By combining these two axes, volcano plots highlight genes that show both large expression changes and strong statistical support, making it easier to identify potentially biologically meaningful up‑ and down‑regulated genes within each cell type.

## 🔍 Interpretation Guidelines

**Up-regulated genes (red-right side)**

Genes plotted in red on the right side can represent transcriptional programs increased or activated in the given cell type or the condition for the given cell type.

- log2FC > 1 (higher expression in the given cell type or the condition within the given cell type, e.g. Treatment vs Control)
- p-value ≤ α (statistically significant)

Depending on the DE comparison, these genes may indicate:

- cell-type-specific markers
- pathway activation
- treatment-induced responses
- cell-state transitions
- altered signaling or regulatory activity

**Down-regulated genes (red-left side)**

Genes plotted in red on the left side can represent transcriptional programs decreased or inactivated in the given cell type or the condition for the given cell type.

- log2FC < -1 (lower expression in the given cell type or the condition within the given cell type, e.g. Treatment vs Control)
- p-value ≤ α

Depending on the DE comparison, these genes may indicate:

- cell-type-specific markers
- suppressed pathways
- inhibited regulatory programs
- decreased cell-type–specific functions
- loss of activity due to treatment or condition

**Non-significant genes (grey)**

Genes shown in grey are:

- not significant at the chosen p-value threshold (p-value > α), and/or
- show only minor fold-change that does not meet the log2FC threshold.

These genes essentially represent background variation or small changes that are unlikely to be biologically meaningful under current criteria.


## 📌 Summary

A volcano plot provides a fast and intuitive overview of differential‑expression (DE) patterns within each cell type and condition.
Note that by default the `EnhancedVolcano()` function uses a cutoff of `1e-05` for α.

### Color Guide

| **Color** | **Meaning**              | **Criteria**                                       |   **Volcano side**                                              |
|-----------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Red**   | Up‑regulated             | log2FC > 1 & p-value ≤ α                  |   Right side (positive log₂FC)                                  |
| **Red**   | Down‑regulated           | log2FC < -1 & p-value ≤ α                  |   Left side (negative log₂FC)                                   |
| **Blue**  | Significant p-value only | p‑value ≤ α but log₂FC < threshold        |   log₂FC; Both sides (near 0 log₂FC)                            |
| **Green** | High fold‑change only    | log₂FC ≥ threshold but p‑value > α        |   Left = large negative FC; Right = large positive FC           |
| **Grey**  | Not significant          | p-value > α and log₂FC < threshold        |   Center region around log₂FC ≈ 0                               |

This visualization helps identify genes that show both statistical significance at the given α and potentially biologically meaningful fold‑change in a cell‑type-specific manner.


# Set up

```{r load-library, echo=TRUE}
attach(params)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(knitr)
  library(DT)
  library(glue)
  library(EnhancedVolcano)
}) 
```

# Directories and paths to file Inputs/Outputs

```{r set-dir-and-file-names, echo=TRUE}
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "de-go-analysis")
config_util <- file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "function-de-go-config.R")
if (!file.exists(config_util)) {
  config_util <- "util/function-de-go-config.R"
}
source(config_util)

dego_mode <- normalize_dego_mode_label(dego_condition_comparison_mode)
min_cells_per_group <- resolve_dego_min_cells_param(min_cells_per_group, root_dir)
markers_dir_module <- dego_results_de_dir(analysis_dir, dego_mode)
module_plots_dir <- dego_module_plots_dir(analysis_dir, dego_mode)
read_dego_markers_for_plots <- function(path) {
  read_dego_markers_filtered(path, min_cells_per_group)
}

# Input files
markers_file_overall <- file.path(markers_dir_module, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all.tsv"))
markers_file_condition_value1 <- file.path(markers_dir_module, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all_condition_value1.tsv"))
markers_file_condition_value2 <- file.path(markers_dir_module, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all_condition_value2.tsv"))
markers_file_condition_value3 <- file.path(markers_dir_module, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all_condition_value3.tsv"))
show_global_interaction <- dego_mode %in% c("global_interaction", "both")
show_within_celltype <- dego_mode %in% c("within_celltype", "both")
within_markers_file <- function(suffix) {
  file.path(
    markers_dir_module,
    glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_within_celltype_{suffix}.tsv")
  )
}

# Create plots directory
plots_dir <- file.path(module_plots_dir, "02-volcano-plots") 
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir)}

plots_dir_overall <- file.path(plots_dir, "01-volcano-plots-overall") 
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_overall)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir_overall)}

plots_dir_condition1 <- file.path(plots_dir, "02-volcano-plots-condition1") 
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_condition1)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir_condition1)}

# Source functions
source(paste0(analysis_dir, "/util/function-create-volcano-plot.R"))
```

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
opts_chunk$set(fig.align='center',
               external=TRUE,
               echo=FALSE,
               warning=FALSE,
               fig.pos='H')
a4width <- 8.3
a4height <- 11.7
```

# Minimum cell count filter (`min_cells_per_group_dego_module`)

Volcano plots use the same threshold as the DE module: **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells. Identities below this count are omitted (see `Res_*_Low_cell_*.tsv` and `Res_*_Skipped_celltypes_*.tsv` under `results/results_`r dego_mode`/01-de-analysis/`).

```{r volcano-min-cells-summary, echo=TRUE, results='asis'}
excl_summary_volcano <- summarize_dego_min_cells_exclusions(markers_dir_module, resolution_list)
if (nrow(excl_summary_volcano) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Exclusions applied to volcano inputs\n\n")
  print(kable(excl_summary_volcano))
} else {
  cat("\n\n*No exclusion sidecar files found; marker tables may still be filtered when `cluster_cell_count` or `n_ident1`/`n_ident2` columns are present.*\n\n")
}
```

# Volcano Plots Per Cell Type

The analysis labels the top `r n_value` genes ranked by significance to highlight the most potentially biologically relevant up‑ and down‑regulated features.

## Overall

```{r volcano-plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.fullwidth = TRUE, echo=TRUE}
all.markers_overall <- read_dego_markers_for_plots(markers_file_overall)
volcano_plot_results <- create_volcano_plot(all.markers = all.markers_overall, n_value = n_value, plots_dir = plots_dir_overall)
```

## Global interaction — per `r condition_value1`

```{r volcano-plot-condition1, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.fullwidth = TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=show_global_interaction}
all.markers_condition_value1 <- read_dego_markers_for_plots(markers_file_condition_value1)
volcano_plot_results <- create_volcano_plot(all.markers = all.markers_condition_value1, n_value = n_value, plots_dir = plots_dir_condition1)
```

## Global interaction — per `r condition_value2`

```{r volcano-plot-condition2, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.fullwidth = TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=show_global_interaction}
if (!is.null(condition_value2)) {
  
  all.markers_condition_value2 <- read_dego_markers_for_plots(markers_file_condition_value2)

  plots_dir_condition2 <- file.path(plots_dir, "03-volcano-plots-condition2") 
  if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_condition2)) {
    dir.create(plots_dir_condition2)}
  
  volcano_plot_results <- create_volcano_plot(all.markers = all.markers_condition_value2, n_value = n_value, plots_dir = plots_dir_condition2)
}
```

## Global interaction — per `r condition_value3`

```{r volcano-plot-condition3, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.fullwidth = TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=show_global_interaction}
if (!is.null(condition_value3)) {
    
  all.markers_condition_value3 <- read_dego_markers_for_plots(markers_file_condition_value3)

  plots_dir_condition3 <- file.path(plots_dir, "04-volcano-plots-condition3") 
  if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_condition3)) {
    dir.create(plots_dir_condition3)}
  
  volcano_plot_results <- create_volcano_plot(all.markers = all.markers_condition_value3, n_value = n_value, plots_dir = plots_dir_condition3)
}
```

# Within cell type — volcano plots

Each volcano is one **cell type** (`cluster`). The x-axis is `avg_log2FC` from [FindMarkers()](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/findmarkers) comparing **ident.1 vs ident.2** within that cell type (same contrast for all panels in a condition block). Plot subtitles repeat ident.1 / ident.2.

## Within cell type — per `r condition_value1`

```{r within-contrast-volcano-v1, echo=FALSE, eval=show_within_celltype, results='asis'}
all.markers_within_v1 <- read_dego_markers_for_plots(within_markers_file("condition_value1"))
contrast_v1 <- read_within_celltype_contrast(
  markers_dir_module, resolution_list, "condition_value1", all.markers_within_v1
)
cat_within_celltype_contrast_report(contrast_v1, all.markers_within_v1, condition_value1)
```

```{r volcano-within-condition1, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, fig.fullwidth = TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=show_within_celltype}
plots_dir_within_v1 <- file.path(plots_dir, "05-volcano-plots-within-celltype-condition1")
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir_within_v1)) dir.create(plots_dir_within_v1)
volcano_plot_results <- create_volcano_plot(all.markers = all.markers_within_v1, n_value = n_value, plots_dir = plots_dir_within_v1)
```
